sources.entry: AudioMuse-AI | Local sonic analysis that generates smart playlists for Jellyfin, Navidrome, Emby, Plex and LMS

summary.one_liner: AudioMuse-AI is a self-hosted tool that uses local sonic analysis to build playlists, clusters, and searches over a music library for Navidrome, Jellyfin, LMS, Lyrion, Emby, and Plex without relying on metadata or external APIs.
summary.what_it_does: It analyzes the audio of songs in your library to find sonically similar tracks, then uses that to make playlists, group songs into clusters, and draw a 2D genre-based music map. Users can generate playlists from a text prompt (e.g. "high-tempo, low-energy music"), from a seed track, from listening history (Sonic Fingerprint), or as a path between two songs. Song Alchemy lets you mark tracks ADD or SUBTRACT and export the result to your media server. The README also describes text search by mood or instrument, lyrics search by theme (72 languages), and recording-based search where a 20-second clip identifies a song. It can connect several media servers to one deployment, detecting duplicates so each track is analyzed once. Setup is mostly done through a browser Setup Wizard, with PostgreSQL as the database.
use_cases: generate smart playlists from my music library
find songs similar to a track I like
search my music by mood, instrument or lyrics theme
identify a song playing nearby from a recording
run one music analysis service for several media servers
how_to_run: Open the Web UI, then go to Analysis and Clustering and click Start Analysis
stack: Native packages for macOS, Linux (.deb/.rpm) and Windows
notable: Works with several media servers at once, with duplicate detection so each song is analyzed only once
Analysis runs locally and does not depend on metadata or external APIs
Setup Wizard in the browser handles configuration after a minimal env file
Native apps bundle embedded PostgreSQL for macOS, Linux and Windows without Docker
Search by Recording: identify a song from a 20-second clip
caveats: Requires a CPU with AVX2 support; virtual CPUs without it (e.g. default QEMU) will not start the app
Native macOS build runs only on Apple Silicon, Windows build only on x86_64, and the apps are unsigned
Lyrics search works only for the 72 listed languages
Minimum 8 GB RAM and NVMe SSD recommended
keywords: share playlists with my media server
